# Boudoir Photography Auckland: boudoir & maternity photography for women in Auckland

> Boudoir Photography Auckland provides private boudoir and maternity photography sessions on Auckland's Hibiscus Coast, New Zealand. Run by Belinda Dunne, a female photographer with Master Level accreditation from The Portrait Masters, focused on posing and lighting. Belinda shoots every session herself, takes on only one client per day, and includes unedited images alongside edited ones with every package.

## Services

- [Boudoir Photography](/): Private, confidence-boosting boudoir sessions. Packages from $750.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Tease ($750, 1.5hr, 6 images), Temptation ($950, 2.5hr, 10 images), Total Knockout ($1,200, unlimited time, 20 images). Every package includes matching unedited images.
- [Maternity Photography](/maternity-photography): Elegant, guided maternity portrait sessions.
- [Bridal Boudoir](/bridal-boudoir-auckland): A relaxed, guided boudoir session before your wedding, whether it is a gift for your partner or entirely for you.
- [Boudoir for Every Body](/boudoir-for-every-body/): Plus size boudoir, boudoir before a mastectomy, with burn or surgical scars, and after weight loss surgery. Every size, age and colour.
- [Birthday Boudoir](/milestone-birthday-boudoir/): 30th, 40th and 50th birthday boudoir sessions, and birthday gift vouchers.
- [What to Wear](/what-to-wear-boudoir-shoot): Wardrobe guide for your boudoir shoot.
- [Testimonials](/testimonials): Reviews from real boudoir clients.
- [Boudoir Gallery](/boudoir-photoshoot-gallery-auckland): Real client images from real sessions.
